WITH per_name AS (
  SELECT e.event_name AS event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount
  FROM budget b
  JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
  GROUP BY e.event_name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM per_name
)
SELECT p.event_name,
       p.avg_amount,
       p.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall,
       p.avg_amount / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall
FROM per_name p, overall o
WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg
